units.rawText: The precisely adjusted temperature, the simulation of the ocean, water guns, and of course, the neural projection... I can tell Florence really put a lot of thought into this.

spans.text: The precisely adjusted temperature, the simulation of the ocean, water guns, and of course, the neural projection... I can tell Florence really put a lot of thought into this.

units.rawText: It certainly makes for a unique Christmas... Thank you for putting so much effort into your preparations.
units.displayText: It certainly makes for a unique Christmas... Thank you for putting so much effort into your preparations.

units.rawText: I didn't expect you to say that... Does that mean I have your permission to keep pulling pranks in the future?

units.rawText: Well, if it makes you happy... Ah, but just stick to pranking me. Don't prank the other Dolls.

units.rawText: Well, before I came to the Oasis, I had never met anyone who was willing to help scratch this itch in my heart.

units.rawText: In fact, a lot of people thought I was a weirdo and kept their distance. Ahh~ I remember how even the houseman doctors and trainee nurses hid from me.
